_comment: Tracked required_capabilities.json files under code/ that do not
(including legacy JSON arrays), as of the ledger's creation, whatever
their $schema field says. Each entry is frozen by the SHA-256 of its exact
bytes: a listed manifest may not change until it is fixed completely, at
which point it must be removed. The list may only shrink;
Most entries use a legacy shape; fix them by rewriting each capability as a
{category, action, target, justification} object and adding version and $schema.
